description: Horizontal alignment of a table column, as expressed by a GFM table separator row. None (---) leaves the alignment to the renderer, Left (:---), Center (:---:) and Right (---:) are explicit. Stored on TableBlockContent.ColumnAlignments and preserved across Markdown import, export and the DocumentModel/Notion converters.

values.name: None
values.description: No explicit alignment (---). The renderer decides; the Markdown exporter writes --- back.

values.name: Left
values.description: Align column content to the leading edge (:---).

values.name: Right
values.description: Align column content to the trailing edge (---:).

examples.title: Alignment is read from the separator row
